known_risks: 中文：2026-08-07 的第二次隔离对照再次否定 0.1.20 候选：动作表现加速，但实际路线位移仍没有明显提升。静态复盘确认旧修正版只覆盖 40 状态水下动作分派器中状态 6/7 的三条坐标积分；当前候选补齐同一分派器状态 2/14、16/17、29 的另外四条直接坐标积分，共覆盖该分派器内全部七条 0.5→坐标写回路径。该补齐尚未通过修后实机验收。 / English: A second isolated comparison on 2026-08-07 rejected the 0.1.20 candidate again: action-rate acceleration was visible, but measured route displacement still did not clearly increase. Static review showed that 0.1.20 covered only the three state-6/7 coordinate integrations in the 40-state underwater-action dispatcher. This candidate adds the four direct coordinate integrations for states 2/14, 16/17, and 29, covering all seven 0.5-to-coordinate-write paths inside that dispatcher. The expanded coverage still awaits post-fix gameplay verification.

中文：只启用本项并关闭 #65，保持 FPS、武器、模拟摇杆幅度、动作与起终点一致；对同一路线计时：基线和启用后各至少三次并比较中位数，同时检查碰撞、转向、上浮/下潜、冲刺与闪避是否过冲。 / English: Enable only this pack and disable #65; keep FPS, weapon, analog-stick magnitude, action, and route endpoints identical. Time the same underwater route for at least three baseline and three enabled runs, compare medians, and also check collision, turning, ascent/descent, dashing, and evasion for overshoot.
license: MIT for repository-authored metadata and patch source; no game assets included.
summary: 中文：把 3DS 静态 ARM 金手指 #13 转换为 JP v96 PPC；根据两轮 2026-08-07 负向实测，除 0xC7 与动作倍率外，现覆盖同一 40 状态水下动作分派器内全部七条直接坐标积分的 0.5→1.0 位移校正；默认关闭，状态为 Runtime Experimental。 / English: Converts 3DS static ARM cheat #13 to JP-v96 PPC. Following two negative gameplay comparisons on 2026-08-07, it now supplements the 0xC7/action-rate mapping with 0.5-to-1.0 corrections for all seven direct coordinate integrations in the same 40-state underwater-action dispatcher; disabled by default and classified Runtime Experimental.
